q: Brent crude's final closing price of the year is below $90 a barrel
basis: On top of the Hormuz blockade, the September shutdown of Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline and its restart at reduced volumes have blocked supply routes twice over. If the forecast on a U.S.-Iran ceasefire and the reopening of Hormuz comes true, this one is likely to come true as well. (Added November 7, 2026.) In early November, hopes of a ceasefire around the U.S. midterm elections drove oil prices sharply lower, shrinking the further fall needed for this forecast to come true.
rs: The ICE Brent front-month futures (March 2027 contract) settlement price on December 31, 2026
